execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."command" (
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text NOT NULL,
  "error" text,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "params" jsonb,
  "requestedById" uuid,
  "result" jsonb,
  "sentAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "command_status_check_55435a5d" CHECK ("status" IN ('queued', 'sent', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'expired'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."device" (
  "bootId" int8,
  "chip" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currentFirmwareId" uuid,
  "elfSha256" text,
  "fwVersion" text,
  "hardwareId" text NOT NULL,
  "health" jsonb,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastConnectedAt" timestamptz,
  "lastDisconnectedAt" timestamptz,
  "lastSeenAt" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "online" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "platform" text NOT NULL,
  "resetReason" text,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "uptimeMs" int8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "device_status_check_3eae755e" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'revoked', 'superseded'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."device_heartbeat" (
  "data" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "receivedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "uptimeMs" int8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."device_log" (
  "bootId" int8,
  "deviceId" text NOT NULL,
  "deviceTimeMs" int8,
  "firmwareId" uuid,
  "id" BIGSERIAL NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "level" int2 NOT NULL,
  "message" text,
  "packetType" int2,
  "raw" bytea,
  "receivedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "seq" int4,
  "tag" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "device_log_kind_check_1363423d" CHECK ("kind" IN ('text', 'bin'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."enrollment_token" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text,
  "deviceName" text,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "usedAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."firmware" (
  "binKey" text NOT NULL,
  "binSha256" text NOT NULL,
  "buildTime" text,
  "chip" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "elfKey" text,
  "elfSha256" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idfVersion" text,
  "notes" text,
  "ownerId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "platform" text NOT NULL,
  "projectName" text NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "version" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ota_job" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "firmwareId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "ownerId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ota_task" (
  "commandId" uuid,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deviceId" text NOT NULL,
  "error" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "jobId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "previousElfSha256" text,
  "progress" int2 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ota_task_status_check_2bbbd189" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'sent', 'downloading', 'verifying', 'rebooting', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastUsedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_check_5b6d1a59" CHECK ("role" IN ('user', 'admin'))
)
